description: Ministry of Justice Prison Affairs and Constitutional Reforms - Incorporation of the Sarana Development Trust Under Section114 of the Trust Ordinance.
reasoning: This gazette notification concerns the incorporation of a trust under Section 114 of the Trusts Ordinance (Chapter 87). It is a legal order issued by the Minister of Justice, which creates a new legal entity ("Sarana Development Trust") and defines its legal capacities (to acquire property, sue and be sued). This content fits the definition of Type 5 (Legal/Regulatory Gazettes) as it involves the establishment of a legal framework and regulatory matter through a statutory instrument, specifically under an existing ordinance. While a government minister is named, the primary purpose is not about the government's structure or personnel but about creating a legal entity.
